title: Underworld kingpin ‘Batuwatte Chamara’ brough back to Sri Lanka
byline: Notorious underworld figure and drug trafficker Manoj Suranga, also known as “Batuwatte Chamara”, who was arrested in Azerbaijan recently, has been brought back to Sri Lanka this evening (10), police said.

title: Oil jumps as US and Iran disagree on peace proposal
byline: Oil prices jumped $3 a barrel on Monday as the United States and Iran failed to agree to a peace proposal drafted by Washington while the Strait of Hormuz remained largely closed, keeping global energy supplies tight.

title: Trump calls Iran’s response to US peace proposal ‘unacceptable’
byline: President Donald Trump on Sunday rejected Iran’s response to a U.S. proposal for peace talks, dashing hopes for an imminent end to the 10-week-old conflict that has caused widespread damage in Iran and Lebanon, paralyzed maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz and driven up global energy prices.

title: Adolescence makes history at Bafta TV Awards
byline: Netflix drama Adolescence was the big winner at the Bafta Television Awards on Sunday, while The Celebrity Traitors and Last One Laughing also scooped a share of the glory.

title: French national shows symptoms on return from hantavirus-hit ship
byline: A passenger of a cruise ship that was struck by an outbreak of hantavirus has shown symptoms of the disease while being repatriated to France, the country’s prime minister has said.

title: Heavy rainfall above 100 mm expected in parts of the island
byline: According to the latest weather analysis based on last morning (10), the low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka is likely to develop into a low-pressure area around the next 48 hours, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Netanyahu wants to wean Israel off US military support, he tells CBS
byline: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu hopes to wean Israel off U.S. military support within a decade as his country pushes to strengthen ties with Gulf states, he said in an interview that aired on Sunday.

title: All sand mining permits in Mannar temporarily suspended
byline: All sand mining permits in the Mannar District have been temporarily suspended following concerns that have arisen regarding the issuance of permits in the district.

title: ‘Yal Devi’ train services resume from today
byline: The Department of Railways says the “Yal Devi” train will resume operations between Colombo Fort and Kankesanthurai (KKS) railway stations from today (11).

title: New electricity tariff revision takes effect from today
byline: The electricity tariff revision for the second and third quarters of this year is scheduled to be implemented from today (11).

title: Landslide early warnings issued to areas in five districts
byline: The National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) has issued a landslide early warning for several Divisional Secretariat Divisions (DSDs) in five districts in view of the prevailing adverse weather conditions in parts of the country.

title: Turkish Airlines plane evacuated due to tyre fire after landing in Kathmandu
byline: A tyre of a Turkish Airlines plane caught fire after it landed on Monday in Nepal’s capital of Kathmandu, authorities said, forcing the closure of the airport for an hour.

title: Former Thai PM Thaksin Shinawatra released from prison on parole
byline: Thailand’s former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, whose 21st-century political odyssey sharply divided Thai society for decades, was released from a Bangkok prison on Monday after serving eight months of a one-year sentence for a corruption-related charge.

title: Three killed in separate road accidents across the island
byline: A total of three individuals have died in separate road accidents reported from different parts of the island, police said.

title: 29-year-old arrested with stock of ‘Ice’ in Attidiya
byline: A 29-year-old man was arrested with 76 grams and 100 milligrams of ‘Ice’ (crystal methamphetamine) in the Kahawita area of Attidiya.

title: Fire breaks out near Dam Street Police Station; 10 fire trucks deployed to contain blaze
byline: A fire has broken out in a building opposite the Dam Street Police Station in Colombo.

title: Udaya Gammanpila appears before TID to record statement
byline: The leader of the Pivithuru Hela Urumaya, former Minister Udaya Gammanpila today (11) appeared before the Terrorism Investigation Division (TID) to record a statement.

title: Case against Shashi Weerawansa adjourned till May 25
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court has ordered that the case filed against Shashi Weerawansa, the wife of former Minister Wimal Weerawansa, be taken up again on May 25, Ada Derana reporter said.

title: Water tariff revision on June 30: Water Supply Minister
byline: The next revision of water tariffs will take place on June 30, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply, (Dr.) Susil Ranasinghe has stated.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva, North-Central, Eastern provinces and in the Kurunegala, Mullaitivu, Mannar, Vavuniya districts.

title: Meteorologists predict continued rain in the upcoming days as reservoirs near capacity limits
byline: Heavy rainfall caused by the prevailing weather conditions may lead to rising water levels in reservoirs across the country, according to the Department of Irrigation.

title: Iran describes its proposal to end war with US as ‘legitimate’
byline: Iran’s proposal to end the war with the US and reopen the Strait of Hormuz was legitimate and generous, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said on Monday (May 11), adding that the US continues to uphold unreasonable and one-sided demands.

title: 84% of Sri Lankans willing to donate eyes, Health Ministry says
byline: Around 84% of the population in Sri Lanka have expressed willingness to donate their eyes, according to the Ministry of Health.

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa to appear before Bribery Commission amid legal dispute over evidence validity
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa is scheduled to appear before the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) tomorrow (12), according to his media spokesperson Attorney Manoj Gamage.

title: Dua Lipa sues Samsung for $15m over use of her image on TV boxes
byline: Pop star Dua Lipa has filed a $15m (£11m) lawsuit against Samsung, alleging it used her image on packaging for its televisions without permission.

title: Low-pressure area forms over Bay of Bengal, Met Dept. warns of continued rain and rough seas
byline: The atmospheric disturbance that prevailed over the Bay of Bengal has developed into a low-pressure area, the Department of Meteorology has stated.

title: Government allows private sector to distribute urea fertilizer
byline: The government has decided to permit the private-sector to distribute urea fertilizer, according to Director General of the Department of Agriculture, Dr. Thushara Wickramaarachchi.

title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte impeached for a second time
byline: The Philippine House of Representatives has voted to impeach Vice-President Sara Duterte for a second time, threatening her plan to run for president in 2028.

title: Death row inmate in Amarakeerthi Athukorala case dies after fall at Welikada Prison
byline: A detainee who had been sentenced to death in connection with the killing of former Polonnaruwa District Member of Parliament Amarakeerthi Athukorala has died after falling from a building within the Welikada Prison.

title: Level 2 landslide warning issued to residents of Passara
byline: Level 2 landslide warning has been issued to residents of Passara Divisional Secretariat Divisions (DSD) of the Badulla district owing to incessant rains experienced in parts of the island.

title: Flooding displaces families across 14 GS divisions in Galewela
byline: Heavy rainfall has caused widespread flooding, displacing numerous families across 14 Grama Niladhari divisions in the Galewela Divisional Secretariat area.

title: Police launch crackdown on illegal vehicle modifications and noisy exhaust systems
byline: Sri Lanka Police have announced that strict legal action will be taken against vehicles fitted with unauthorized modifications and excessively noisy exhaust systems, as part of ongoing efforts to improve road safety and enforce traffic regulations across the country.

title: Heavy rains over 100 mm forecast across Sri Lanka as low-pressure system intensifies
byline: The Department of Meteorology has warned that heavy showers exceeding 100 mm are likely in several parts of the country due to the influence of a low-pressure area located to the northeast of Sri Lanka.

title: Newborn death probe at Trinco Hospital leads to suspension of two medical officers
byline: The Director General of Health Services has decided to suspend a consultant obstetrician and gynecologist along with a senior resident medical officer attached to the Trincomalee District General Hospital, following a preliminary investigation into the death of a newborn during childbirth on April 9.

title: India faces risk of weaker monsoon, raising inflation and growth concerns
byline: India could be heading into a weaker-than-usual monsoon season this year, raising concerns about inflation and the broader economy.

title: GMOA denies any link to Trincomalee newborn death
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has denied any connection between its trade union activities and the death of a newborn during a delivery at the Trincomalee District General Hospital.

title: Suspect remanded over Rs. 18 million gold fraud case
byline: An individual arrested in connection with a large-scale fraud involving the alleged promise of five kilograms of gold has been remanded until tomorrow (12) by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: President reviews progress of “Prajashakthi” National Movement
byline: Of the Rs. 25, 000 million allocated under the 2026 Budget for the “Prajashakthi” National Poverty Alleviation Programme, development projects valued at Rs. 23,000 million have already been approved and forwarded to District Secretaries for implementation, the President’s Media Division said in a statement.

title: 54 foreign nationals arrested in Hikkaduwa over suspected cybercrime activities
byline: A total of 54 foreign nationals have been arrested today (11) at a tourist hotel in Dodanduwa, Hikkaduwa, on suspicion of involvement in cyber-related criminal activities, the Special Task Force (STF) said.

title: Spill gates at several reservoirs opened amid heavy rainfall
byline: A total of four spill gates of the Deduru Oya Reservoir have been raised and opened to a height of two feet each, the Department of Irrigation stated.

title: Udawalawa Reservoir sees massive 35,000 kg fish harvest following heavy rains
byline: More than 35,000 kilograms of fish were harvested from the Udawalawa Reservoir over just two days — May 9 and 10 — according to the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka.

title: Batuwatte Chamara detained for 72 hours for questioning
byline: Notorious underworld figure and alleged drug trafficker Manoj Suranga Liyanage, widely known as “Batuwatte Chamara,” was taken into custody for questioning following his repatriation to Sri Lanka after being arrested in Azerbaijan.

title: Tens of millions risk hunger as Hormuz standoff blocks fertiliser, UN official says
byline: Tens of millions of people could face hunger and starvation if fertilisers are not soon allowed through the Strait of Hormuz, the head of a UN task force aimed at averting a looming humanitarian crisis told AFP on Monday (May 11).

title: Donald Trump’s China visit set to test fragile truce
byline: Beijing has confirmed that US President Donald Trump will travel to China this week to meet Xi Jinping.
